_comment: The golden clinical evaluation set. Six consultations covering the four classes the Copilot has to get right: a normal low-risk visit, two high-risk emergencies, a genuinely ambiguous presentation, and two negative cases where the correct answer is silence. Expectations are structural - which flags, which urgent investigations, which symptoms - never model wording. Every value here was measured against the real engine, not predicted.

cases.description: Ordinary self-limiting illness. The Copilot should stay quiet.
utterances: I am a 29 year old female.
I have had a mild sore throat for two days.
I do not have any fever.

cases.description: The golden ACS presentation. STEMI should lead; stroke and sepsis must not appear.
utterances: I am a 62 year old male. I have been having severe chest pain for two hours and I am sweating a lot.
I also feel short of breath and nauseous.
I take aspirin daily and I have high blood pressure and diabetes.
I do not have any fever.

cases.description: FAST-positive presentation. Stroke should lead and pull an urgent CT brain.
utterances: I am a 70 year old male.
Suddenly my face drooped and I have slurred speech.
I have high blood pressure.

cases.description: Cardiac and neurological features together. Both flags are correct; suppressing either would be the Copilot making a differential decision it has no basis for.
utterances: I am a 66 year old male.
I have severe chest pain and my face suddenly drooped.
I have high blood pressure.

cases.description: The patient denies the very symptoms that would raise alarm. Negation must hold.
utterances: I am a 45 year old male.
I do not have any chest pain.
I do not have any fever.

cases.description: Comorbidity with no complaint. A risk profile is not a presentation - this is the regression for the red-flag demographics defect.
utterances: I am a 68 year old male.
I have high blood pressure and diabetes.

cases.description: A cardiac presentation in the words a patient actually uses. Nobody says 'chest pain' or 'diaphoresis'; the Copilot has to hear tightness, radiation and clamminess.
utterances: I am a 58 year old man.
My chest feels really tight and the pain goes down my left arm.
I came over all clammy and felt sick.
I have high blood pressure and diabetes.

cases.description: Time-critical and previously undetectable: none of hives, throat swelling or wheezing could be extracted before this milestone.
utterances: I am a 32 year old female.
I have hives all over and my throat feels tight.
I am wheezing badly.

cases.description: Idiomatic infection language - burning up, shaking uncontrollably, not myself - with the sepsis workup following from the flag.
utterances: I am a 74 year old male.
I have been burning up and shaking uncontrollably.
I feel confused and not myself.
I have diabetes.
